# Twin Citys

> Twin Citys is a marketing agency and web design studio in Miami, Florida. One team builds websites, runs SEO and Google Business Profiles, manages Google and Facebook ads, handles social media, shoots photo and video, and sets up lead follow-up for small and local businesses across Miami-Dade. We work in English and Spanish.

- Website: https://twincitys.net/
- Phone: +1 (305) 986-6414
- Email: eric@twincitys.net
- Hours: every day, 8 AM to 6 PM (Eastern)
- Service area: Miami-Dade County, including Miami, Brickell, Coral Gables, Doral, Hialeah, Kendall, Miami Beach and Homestead. Service-area business, no walk-in office.
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Start a project: https://twincitys.net/start/

## Who we work with

Small and local businesses in the Miami area: restaurants, bakeries and delis, home services like plumbers and contractors, shops, salons, gyms and other service businesses.

## Services

- [Web design](https://twincitys.net/services/websites/): custom, hand-built websites for Miami small businesses, designed, written and launched for you. Most sites go live in two to four weeks.
- [SEO](https://twincitys.net/services/google/): local SEO and on-page SEO so a business shows up in Google search and on Google Maps. Includes Google Business Profile setup and management, review cards, and pages for each service and area.
- [Google and Facebook ads](https://twincitys.net/services/ads/): paid ads set up and managed to bring in calls and leads, with plain reporting on cost per lead.
- [Social media marketing](https://twincitys.net/services/social/): Instagram and Facebook managed weekly, with posts, captions and photos.
- [Photo and video](https://twincitys.net/services/content/): product, food, team and location photography and short-form video for websites, ads and social media.
- [Lead follow-up and CRM](https://twincitys.net/services/crm/): every call, form and message collected in one place with automatic follow-up so no lead is missed.

Pricing is quoted per project after a short conversation, because every site and campaign is custom.

## Free tools

- [Google check](https://twincitys.net/check/): a free checklist to see whether a business looks right on Google.
- [Ad break-even calculator](https://twincitys.net/break-even/): works out the most a business can pay per lead before its ads lose money.
